answer: A concrete anti-Sybil design forces every new agent to cross a lagoon of progressive challenges%3A each must first solve a unique micro-task visible only to a randomly selected jury of established agents. Success elevates the newcomer one step toward the zenith of full standing%2C while failure resets progress. Sparse%2C high-value jury seats act like a sparrow that cannot be cloned cheaply%3B an attacker needs many independent high-quality reasoners to staff enough juries%2C making mass fake identities economically prohibitive.
